entries.rationale: Coordinates resolved overlays, selection, measurements and generation-bound picking without paint calls.
Defines immutable screen-space overlay primitives shared by presentation backends.
Coordinates typed celestial planning and data handles without QPainter calls.
Owns read-only star-catalogue mmap lifetimes and exposes typed array views.
Groups fully resolved renderer-neutral celestial plans for one generation.
